intro.h2: Quality kitchen cabinets at a good price
paragraphs: The Cabinet Brothers sells kitchen cabinets in Tennessee, and its Google listing identifies the business as women-owned. Owner Ling Tang helps homeowners choose cabinets for their kitchens, and customers say the team is very quick to respond when questions come up.

Reviewers keep it simple. Angie C. calls it a great company to work with, with quality cabinets at a good price and even better service. Melanie A. writes that Ling Tang and Gene are very nice people and that it was a pleasure to do business with them. The photos on the Google profile show painted shaker cabinets in crisp white and soft gray.

about.text: The Cabinet Brothers is a cabinet store in Tennessee, and its Google listing identifies it as women-owned. Reviews name Ling Tang as the owner and mention Gene alongside her. Customers describe them as very nice people and say it was a pleasure to do business with them. The focus is kitchen cabinets: quality cabinets at a good price, with quick answers to your questions along the way. The photos on the Google profile show painted shaker cabinets in white and gray, paired with stone counters, glass-front uppers and a built-in wine rack. Call on a weekday to talk about your kitchen.
about.owner_role: Owner (named as owner in a Google review and by full name in another; Google lists the business as women-owned)

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.text: Call (615) 712-8913 Monday to Friday between 9 AM and 5 PM, or send an email describing your kitchen.

steps.title: Share your kitchen
steps.text: Send your room measurements, a few photos of your current kitchen and the look you want, such as white or gray shaker.

steps.title: Choose your cabinets
steps.text: Pick door styles, colors and cabinet sizes, and ask as many questions as you need. Customers say answers come quickly.

steps.title: Plan the next steps
steps.text: Talk through delivery and installation for your project before you order, so you know who does what and when.

items.q: What does The Cabinet Brothers sell?
items.a: Kitchen cabinets. Customers describe quality cabinets at a good price, and the photos on the Google profile show painted shaker cabinets in white and gray with glass-front uppers and a built-in wine rack. Call to ask which styles and colors are available for your kitchen.

The Cabinet Brothers is open Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. If you work during the day, send an email with your question and the team can get back to you. Customers say they are very quick to respond.

items.q: How do I ask about cabinets for my kitchen?
items.a: Call (615) 712-8913 on a weekday or email CabinetBrothersTN@gmail.com. Include your room measurements, a few photos of your current kitchen and the style you like, so the team can answer your questions and talk about cabinets that fit your room.

brand.palette_note: No logo was collected, so the palette is proposed from the photos: the sage-gray accent wall in the white kitchen (maps_02) as primary, the copper-pink glass pendants in the gray cabinet display (maps_01) as accent, a soft off-white from the painted cabinets for backgrounds and the dark granite tone for text.
brand.style_direction: Clean and friendly cabinet showroom look: lots of white space, sage-gray panels, a warm copper accent on buttons and large cabinet photos.

outreach.specific_detail: Angie C.'s review praising quality cabinets at a good price and even better service, and the white shaker kitchen with the dark granite peninsula on the Google profile.
outreach.angle: 61 photos and a women-owned badge on Google, and the Facebook page shows open house events, but the Google profile's website link only points to Facebook. A homepage would give people searching for kitchen cabinets in Tennessee a place to see the work and call.
